scenes.speaker: a
scenes.narration: Should we gate every request? I say yes, because one missed check is a breach, and a breach costs far more than a few milliseconds.

visual.question: Should we gate every request?
visual.quote: One missed check is a breach.

scenes.speaker: b
scenes.narration: Hold on. Every request means one more network hop, and our budget is two hundred milliseconds in total.

scenes.speaker: b
scenes.narration: So where does the time budget go? Most of it is already spent in the database, before the gate even runs.

visual.question: Where does the time budget go?

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.narration: Then we measure it first. Measure, decide, and only then add the gate, one hop at a time.

visual.heading: The plan
visual.text: Then add the gate, one hop at a time
